key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
AUD smashed on growth scare; mortgage rates shooting up ahead of CPI data
Oil prices surging toward $120 on Middle East escalation, but China's 70% EV target threatens long-term demand
RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern; ANZ.AX cutting 3,500 jobs amid restructuring
Housing market bifurcating: high-end prices crashing while affordable segment remains resilient
Mining cap raises accelerating as Canaccord-led fundraising signals sector stress
Australia softens gas supply rules, easing Asian energy security fears for Santos.AX, Woodside.AX

sectors.trend: Severely negative. Iron ore in active 'bloodletting' phase; ASX miners leading the $90bn index decline. Cap raises surging as Canaccord leads mining fundraising dash. Gold underperforming ('gold schmould'). Small-caps (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) showing relative strength.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) lack safe-haven bid. Small-cap explorers (Kuniko, Gateway WA) offer speculative upside but elevated risk.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and rate fears pressuring valuations. ANZ.AX restructuring with 3,500 job cuts signals cost discipline but weakens growth narrative. CD rates at 4.35% APY reflect tightening conditions.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX face NIM pressure from rate volatility. ANZ.AX restructuring may support near-term margins but caps upside. Mortgage rate surge ahead of CPI could trigger credit quality concerns.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-positive short-term. Oil surging toward $120 on Middle East conflict; Australian fuel prices rising 30c. However, China's 70% EV target threatens structural oil demand. Australia softening gas supply rules supports Santos.AX, Woodside.AX.
sectors.implications: Santos.AX, Woodside.AX benefit from relaxed gas export rules. Oil majors face geopolitical upside but EV demand overhang. Fuel cost inflation pressures consumer sector.

sectors.trend: Under pressure. Woolworths.WSW breaching 'Price Freeze' on staples signals margin squeeze. Housing correction boosting first-home buyer activity but high-end crash. Businesses reporting fear for future.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WES.AX face input cost inflation. REITs pressured by rental inflation focus. Consumer discretionary vulnerable to rate-driven affordability squeeze.

sectors.trend: Relatively resilient. Critical Resources battery tech passing month-long test. ASX small-caps (Iondrive, Neurizon) showing momentum. CSL.AX likely providing defensive bid amid broad selloff.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX offer defensive positioning. Battery/energy storage names (Critical Resources) benefit from transition theme despite oil volatility.

key_themes: Rate-rise fears and rising bond yields driving broad ASX selloff
Iron ore structural decline pressuring materials sector
Oil supply shock vs. EV demand destruction creating energy sector divergence
AUD weakness amplifying import inflation and cost-of-living pressures
Housing market bifurcation: luxury crash vs. affordable resilience
Superannuation policy debate intensifying with populist pressure
Mining sector capital raises signal liquidity stress
RBA rental inflation focus may delay rate cuts

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; diversify into gold or energy
Shorten duration; favour floating-rate instruments; monitor CPI data release

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike / Middle East escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge fuel-cost exposure; favour Santos.AX, Woodside.AX over oil importers
Favour domestic-revenue companies; avoid USD-cost-heavy importers
Avoid luxury REITs; monitor first-home buyer data for policy response

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mining sector liquidity / cap raise dilution
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid small-cap miners with imminent raises; favour cash-flow-positive majors

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Australian gas producers on relaxed supply rules
opportunities.rationale: Softened gas export rules ease Asian security fears; oil spike supports gas substitution demand

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt to healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Broad ASX selloff creates relative value in defensive sectors; CSL.AX, WES.AX offer income and stability

opportunities.recommendation: Selective small-cap mining exposure on battery/energy transition
opportunities.rationale: Critical Resources battery tech validation; Iondrive, Aruma showing relative strength amid sector weakness

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore / thermal coal exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in active bloodletting; China EV target structurally threatens coal demand; $90bn ASX loss concentrated in miners

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk with short-duration or floating-rate instruments
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA rental inflation concern delays cuts; mortgage rates surging ahead of CPI; bond yields rising

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid luxury REITs and high-end property exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest price falls at top end; housing correction may extend; first-home buyer surge suggests policy shift risk

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to extend weakness on iron ore decline, oil-driven inflation fears, and AUD pressure. CPI data release will be pivotal. RBA hawkish tilt on rental inflation limits rate-cut expectations. Expect continued miner/bank underperformance.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction may stabilise; gas supply rule changes support energy sector; battery/energy transition offers structural growth. However, iron ore structural decline and China EV shift cap materials upside. Superannuation policy debate could create tailwind for financials if resolved constructively.

Iron ore price trajectory and China demand data
Middle East conflict resolution or escalation
ANZ.AX restructuring progress and cost-out outcomes
Superannuation policy debate / One Nation proposals
China EV adoption rate vs. oil demand
watch_list: Iron ore futures (62% Fe) – bloodletting continuation
RBA cash rate / rental inflation data
Housing auction clearance rates (no spring bounce confirmed)
China EV penetration rate vs. oil import data
